context: Mei and Aoi try to figure out a tricky recipe.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (何とか/遠く/ケーキ/証/ちゃい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: このケーキ、何とか膨らんだね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle relieved delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、温度を上げたのが良かったね。
lines.en: Yeah, raising the temperature was good.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 遠くのお店のレシピ、試したの。
lines.en: I tried a recipe from a faraway shop.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: It's proof you did it well!
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 温度をもう少し上げてみようかな。
lines.en: Maybe I'll raise the temperature a bit more.
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 何とか、お店の味に近づいたね。
lines.en: We somehow got close to the shop's taste.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 頑張った証に、写真を撮ろう。
lines.en: Let's take a photo as proof of our effort.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 遠くの友達にも、送ってあげよう!
lines.en: Let's send it to faraway friends too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
